@Shhaady31 The URDF → USD converter in IsaacLab seems to have issues. I switched to using the official Unitree USD files instead of converting from URDF, and it works fine.

1. Install Git LFS
sudo apt update
sudo apt install git-lfs    # Ubuntu / Debian
git lfs install

2. Clone the official Unitree models
git clone https://huggingface.co/datasets/unitreerobotics/unitree_model


3. Configure UNITREE_MODEL_DIR
Edit the file from the repo:
source/unitree_rl_lab/unitree_rl_lab/assets/robots/unitree.py
Change this line:
UNITREE_MODEL_DIR = "</home/user/projects/unitree_usd>"

4. Replace unitree.py
Replace this repo's unitree.py file with the one from 👉 https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_rl_lab.git

This bypasses the URDF→USD conversion problem and should be no errors.
